method: Actual GardenV2, synthetic validated state and fail-closed loopback action interception; trusted desktop mouse/keyboard and phone-sized CDP touch input on Mac GPU.
notes: Null means unexercised in that scenario, not a failed check.
Seed pointer priority/out-and-back drag rejection: empty scenes. Original UUID history: populated scenes. Ground tap, all13type choices, repeated planting and lifecycle: all scenarios.
Latest empty-scene recheck additionally asserts worldroot blur and explicit overlay camera freeze; all4pad target centers unobscured and hint/pad rectangles separate.
Window blur/visibility and cancellation/lost-capture events are injected lifecycle events; normal phone touch uses trusted CDP browser input.
Normal-motion arrival checks use actual GardenV2 arrival, mounted after client hydration to emulate landing handoff.
Only the local Next.js development badge is hidden; production UI is not masked.
All phone scenarios use browser emulation on Mac, not actual phone hardware.
